findings.title: Missing /llms.txt or /ai.txt AI context manifest
findings.evidence: GET https://www.ikea.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404 and /ai.txt returned HTTP 404.

suggested_action.summary: Optimization Opportunity: Publish a clean markdown /llms.txt file at domain root summarizing the product, architecture, and primary documentation links.

findings.title: Headless render latency (4545ms) exceeds crawl time budget on /
findings.evidence: Hydration and DOM stabilization took 4545ms (threshold: 4500ms). Real-world AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot) operate on strict 3-5 second timeouts and drop slow-rendering pages.

suggested_action.summary: Optimize client bundle size, defer non-critical scripts, or implement server-side pre-rendering to keep time-to-content under 3.5 seconds.

findings.title: Homepage lacks primary Organization or SoftwareApplication entity
findings.evidence: Homepage declared generic schema types (WebSite, OnlineStore, ImageObject, Country, ContactPoint, Country, Person, Place) but lacks an explicit Organization, Brand, or SoftwareApplication definition.
findings.suggested_action: Nest an Organization or SoftwareApplication schema in your homepage JSON-LD to ground your brand in AI Knowledge Graphs.

findings.title: Schema entity (Brand ('IKEA')) lacks description property on /ee/et/p/zebrasaev-laelamp-valge-plast-10522481/
findings.evidence: The Brand ('IKEA') entity has no 'description' field. AI summarizers rely on this field for atomic entity synthesis.
findings.suggested_action: Provide a factual, 1-2 sentence description explaining what the entity is, who uses it, and its core capabilities.

findings.title: Article relies entirely on circular self-citations with zero external reference links
findings.evidence: Page contains 98 links, but 100% of them point back to www.ikea.com. Zero external primary sources or research citations are provided.
findings.suggested_action: Integrate outbound citations to authoritative external sources (standards, benchmarks, institutional studies) to establish a verifiable credibility chain for LLMs.
